title: nan
authors: Yue P.; Xin J.; Huang Y.; Zhao J.; Zhang C.; Chen W.; Shan M.
key_contribution: Presents an air-ground cooperative UAV navigation system using mobile-anchor trilateration, UWB, and environmental modeling with D* Lite path planning for GPS-denied unknown environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
